en:
Nice to meet you all.
My name is Shoji Arai, from Class 2-B.
...Kazama.
It may not be my place as your junior to say this, but frankly, I dislike you.
What was that flippant attitude just now?
You're making a mockery of this project.
This school, you see, truly is home to countless spirits.
The spirits must be more than a little angry at your attitude.
People like you are called swindlers.
Con men, that's what they're called.{p}

...Do you feel even the slightest bit sorry?
I suppose a person like you never feels sorry for anything.
You probably intend to spend your whole life cracking jokes.
...That's fine, I suppose.
It's your life, after all.
However, please do not drag me into it.
If you drag me into it, I will not hesitate to resort to retaliatory measures.
...Well then, let us begin.
Thanks to what you just did, Kazama, I have to change the story I prepared.
You see, the angry spirits must be appeased.
...Allow me to turn off the lights.{p}
"Hold it right there!"{p}

"Now see here, isn't that a bit much?
I'm not fond of resorting to violence, you see.
So I'll keep this civil, but...
Wasn't the way you said that just now uncalled for?"{p}

Arai shot back.
"...Why is that?
I only said what I honestly felt.
I came here in all seriousness.
I thought this would be a more sacred gathering, you see.
And yet you went and ruined it.
Isn't it only natural that I'm angry?
I'm sure everyone gathered here was offended as well."
Muttering all this, Arai ran a slow, crawling gaze over Kazama.
The mood was turning really {f:ugly|ugly}.{p}

What should I do?
Should I {f:step in|step in} and stop them?
Stop them
Watch a little longer

The mood made it {f:hard|hard} to cut in.
{f:I|I} decided to watch a little longer.{p}

"Look here, you.
You're awfully cheeky for a junior.
There's a certain respect you owe your elders, isn't there?
Did I cause you any trouble?
Are you saying I caused you some kind of trouble?"{p}

"Yes.
You most certainly did."
Arai said it flatly.
But those words only seemed to make Kazama {f:angrier|even angrier}.{p}

"...Oh? Now that's interesting.
You've got quite a sense of humor yourself.
So you're saying I caused you trouble, are you?
Even a gentleman like me will resort to violence if you push it too far."
Kazama's face was smiling{f:, but|, but} it was twitching, tight with strain.{p}

"Fine by me.
If you want to resort to barbarism, go right ahead."
Arai wasn't backing down either.
Everyone was watching to see how it would play out.
The mood was getting uglier and {f:uglier|uglier}.{p}
Stop them
I want to watch a little longer

"...I see.
So you want me to resort to violence.
Well then, I'll take you up on that kind offer.
But I'm a rational person, you know.
Before that, why don't you tell me exactly how I've caused you trouble?"
Kazama's hands were shaking.
I could tell he was clenching his fists hard.
...This could be bad.
Maybe Arai, as the junior, should just apologize.{p}

"...I see.
You really are a complete idiot.
So you're telling me you can't understand how you've troubled me unless I go out of my way to spell it out?"
Arai {f:was|was} relentlessly spoiling for a fight.{p}

"...Yeah, that's right.
Because I'm an idiot."
Kazama's voice was shaking.
He was on the verge of {f:snapping|snapping}.{p}

"Because the spirits are angry.
Your stupid jokes have made the spirits angry.
Do you understand?
If this goes on, it won't just be me. Everyone here will suffer for it.
Of course, in your case, you'd only have yourself to blame."
Arai was deadly serious.
His words actually sent a chill through {f:me|me}.
That was how heavy they were.{p}

Everyone was listening to Arai with wide eyes.
It wasn't so much that his words were persuasive. They made you feel that something truly bad was about to happen.{p}
In the heavy silence, Kazama alone laughed.{p}

"Ahahahaha... how ridiculous.
The spirits are angry?
I've been listening this whole time, and what is your deal?
You picking a fight with me?
Come on, you're not a kid anymore.
Try acting a little more grown-up.
Do you seriously believe in stuff like ghosts?"
Kazama was scoffing at the whole thing.
This could be bad.
{f:I|I} had sensed something in this room too, and now I could somehow feel its presence growing stronger.
Maybe the spirits really were angry.
"Don't talk nonsense. Ghosts, my foot.
All those stories you guys have been telling are made up anyway, right?
Not one of you actually believes that stuff.
Ahahahaha..."{p}
Every time Kazama spoke, I could feel the air that filled the room growing wilder.{p}

At this rate, even {f:we|we} might not get out of this unharmed.
But if {f:I|I} butt in, won't it only make things more awkward{f:?|?}{p}What do I do?
Stop them
Watch a little longer

"Please stop it, both of you."
{f:I|I} stood up.
Then I looked at the two of them.
"Please, both of you, stop this already.
{f:We|We} didn't get together to fight.
We asked you all to come here so we could put the school's seven wonders in the newspaper."{p}

"...{a}{f:|}?
I'm trying to help everyone here.
We have to make sure we don't get cursed because of one insolent fool."
Arai had a point too.
Kazama, who had made a joke of the whole thing, was to blame as well{f:.|, wasn't he?}{p}
What {f:am I|am I} supposed to do{f:?|?}
Side with Kazama
Side with Arai

{f:...It couldn't be helped.|He was sulking big-time.}
If I tried to soothe Kazama, things would only get more complicated{f:.|.}{p}

I decided to leave it to Arai.
"...All right then, Arai.
Go ahead, please."
Arai gave a small nod.{p}

"I see.
A wise choice.
Now then, I'll turn off the lights.
The raging spirits must be appeased."{p}

Thank you all for your cooperation.
Let me explain why I turned off the lights.
There's no need to be afraid.
At any rate, the spirit is in an extremely dangerous state right now.
...Strictly speaking, I wonder whether we can even call it a spirit.
I have my doubts about that myself.
It is not so much a spirit as a 'something' that is here.
It seems the people gathered here have a strong sixth sense.
All except one...
So I imagine you can all feel it too.
The presence of that something.
And that it is angry, too.
I turned off the lights so that the something would calm down, even a little.
Because if that presence is in a dangerous state, then we are in a very dangerous position ourselves.
From now on, please do exactly as I say.
If you do, we should somehow be able to escape the danger.{p}Is that understood?
Answer yes
Answer no

...Thank you.
Now then, listen carefully.
Everyone, you must never turn around.
No matter what happens, you absolutely must not turn around.
They say humans are especially sensitive to spirits behind them.
Do you know why?
It's because humans have no eyes in the back of their heads.
They say that because humans came to rely on their eyes, their sixth sense withered away.
When you sense a spirit, you often feel it on your back, don't you?
That's because you have no eyes on your back.
People often say a chill ran down their spine, don't they?
That's the same sort of thing.
Now I'm going to have you all sense that 'something' with your backs.
So even in the dark, whatever you do, don't look behind you.
You may keep your eyes open.
In fact, it would be better to strain your eyes and stare straight ahead.
Instead, focus every nerve you have on your back.
And sense its presence.
Right now, the 'something' should be circling this room.
It should be slowly circling behind each of you.
...Even if you sense its presence, don't panic.
All we have to do is stay calm and keep still.{p}

Well?
Did you sense a presence behind you?{p}

Don't let your guard down.
Even if you break into a sweat, don't wipe it away.
Don't move...
Don't move, focus every nerve...
Don't be startled.
Whatever happens, you mustn't be startled.
Hold your breath...
Focus on your back...{p}

{a}{f:|}?
I feel it's somewhere right behind you now.
I'm sensing a powerful aura from your direction, {a}{f:|}.
Don't you feel something on the back of your neck?
Doesn't it feel like something is clinging to you, prickling your skin?
Don't you feel a lukewarm breath of air blowing on your neck?
Don't turn around.
You absolutely must not turn around...{p}

...Kazama was all right.
But...
There was something unspeakable on Kazama's back.
A creature like a starving ghoul, with a skull-like face and huge, glaring eyeballs, had wrapped its arms around his neck from behind and was clinging to him, draped over his back.
As I stared in shock, {f:the thing|it} vanished in an instant.{p}
As if it had been sucked inside Kazama.{p}

"...Kazama.
You turned around, didn't you?
The truth is, there was never anything behind {a}{f:|}.
That thing was after you from the start.
It was behind you the whole time.
I was waiting for you to turn around."
Arai said this with a smile forming on his lips.
But his eyes weren't smiling.{p}

...Kazama looked dazed.
Maybe it was my imagination, but he looked pale{f:.|.}
"...Really?
Did something happen?
I don't really get it...
There's no such thing as ghosts in this world.
I didn't see anything..."
He seemed {f:terribly sluggish|terribly sluggish}.
All his energy from before was {f:gone|gone}.{p}

"...Kazama.
You've been possessed.
But that doesn't mean it's over.
There are still all sorts of things in this room.
It seems we've drawn them here.
{a}{f:|}.
You saw it clearly just now, didn't you?"
Arai looked at {f:me|me}.{p}What should {f:I|I} say?
I saw it
I didn't see it

Overwhelmed by Arai's intensity, {f:I|I} nodded as if prompted.
Arai looked satisfied.
"...You won't mind if I count what just happened in place of the seven wonders story I was going to tell, will you?
After all, you've experienced something very few people ever get to."
{f:I|I} nodded silently.
Arai's gaze drifted absently through the air, looking at who knows what.
"Ah... there are still so many.
All sorts of things are still here.
I suppose they're after us.
Hm hm hm... If we keep on with the seven wonders, I wonder if even we will make it home safely."{p}

"Now then, {a}{f:|}.
Shall we hear the next person's story?
Mine was the fifth, so the next one will be the last.
It doesn't look like a seventh person is going to show up..."
He was right{f:.|.}
If the seventh person still hadn't come by this late, they probably weren't coming at all{f:.|.}{p}Just one left.
{f:I|I} turned my eyes to the one who remained.
To hear the final story...{p}
Everyone looked at Arai.{p}
Arai...
Apologized
Didn't apologize

Arai bowed his head just slightly.
"...I'm sorry.
The blood rushed to my head, and I just..."
He mumbled it under his breath.{p}

"As long as you understand.
I don't want to stir up trouble for no reason either, you know.
Right?"
His expression stayed stiff, but Kazama seemed to have gotten over it.
Thank goodness.
For a moment there, I didn't know what would happen.
Now Arai could go on with his story.
As {f:I|I} turned to him, I caught my breath.{p}

...Well then, let us continue the story.
Please turn off the lights.{p}

Thank you all for your cooperation.
Let me explain why I turned off the lights.
The truth is, there's something dangerous here right now.
And it is angry.
Anyone with even a little sixth sense should be able to feel it.
I turned off the lights so that the something would calm down, even a little.
Because if that presence is in a dangerous state, then we are in a very dangerous position ourselves.
From now on, please do exactly as I say.
Is that understood?
Everyone, you must never turn around.
No matter what happens, you absolutely must not turn around.
They say humans are especially sensitive to spirits behind them.
Do you know why?{p}

It's because humans have no eyes in the back of their heads.
They say that because humans came to rely on their eyes, their sixth sense withered away.
When you sense a spirit, you often feel it on your back, don't you?
That's because you have no eyes on your back.
People often say a chill ran down their spine, don't they?
That's the same sort of thing.
Now I'm going to have you all sense that 'something' with your backs.
So even in the dark, whatever you do, don't look behind you.
You may keep your eyes open.
In fact, it would be better to strain your eyes and stare straight ahead.{p}

Instead, focus every nerve you have on your back.
And sense its presence.
Right now, the 'something' should be circling this room.
It should be slowly circling behind each of you.
...Even if you sense its presence, don't panic.
All we have to do is stay calm and keep still.
Well?
Did you sense a presence behind you?
Don't let your guard down.
Even if you break into a sweat, don't wipe it away.
Don't move...
Don't move, focus every nerve...
Don't be startled.
Whatever happens, you mustn't be startled.
Hold your breath...
Focus on your back...{p}

{a}{f:|}?
I feel it's somewhere right behind you now.
I'm sensing a powerful aura from your direction, {a}{f:|}.
Don't you feel something on the back of your neck?
Doesn't it feel like something is clinging to you, prickling your skin?
Don't you feel a lukewarm breath of air blowing on your neck?
Don't turn around.
You absolutely must not turn around...
Just then, I felt a lukewarm breath by my ear.
I desperately held back the scream that rose in my throat.
Something was behind {f:me|me}☆
Sweat burst from every pore of my body.
My heart felt like it would leap out of my mouth{f:.|.}
I mustn't turn around.
Arai had said so.
So I {f:can't|can't} turn around.
I knew that.
But...{p}
{f:I|I} turned around.{p}

There was something unspeakable there.
A creature like a starving ghoul, with a skull-like face and huge, glaring eyeballs, was so close it looked ready to bite into me.
...{f:I|I} may have screamed.
An instant later, the thing vanished.{p}

As if it had burrowed into {f:my|my} back.
The moment it did, my body suddenly turned heavy.{p}

At some point, the lights had come on.
Arai was peering down at {f:me|me}.{p}

"{a}{f:|}, you saw it just now, didn't you?"
A whispering voice.
"I told you not to look.
You didn't listen to me, so you've been punished."
{f:What|What}?
What is he {f:talking about|talking about}?{p}

"But you know... the truth is, I knew you would turn around.
You look like the curious type, after all.
So I deliberately called that thing up behind you."
Arai laughed under his breath.
It felt utterly evil.
"You've been possessed......by It."{p}

Possessed?
Who on earth {f:is|is} this 'It'★
Questions whirled around and around in my head.
But I couldn't put them into words.
It was as if my tongue had turned to stone; I couldn't speak.
Was this {f:because|because} I'd been possessed by the 'It' Arai talked about★{p}

Seeing {f:me|me} flustered, Arai narrowed his eyes, looking strangely pleased.
"You're scared.
Because of you, I had to apologize to Kazama.
Considering my pride, this is only what you deserve...... But I bet you've learned your lesson, right down to the bone.
I can't free you from It, but I'll let you move."
The moment he said it, my body suddenly felt light.
Arai grinned.
"It seems you've had a good scare in the dark, {a}{f:|}.
I'll have you count this as my fifth story."
{f:I|I} couldn't say a word.{p}{f:And so|...Well then}, at last, it was down to the final one{f:.|.}{p}

"...I refuse.
Why should I have to apologize?
Kazama is the one in the wrong."
Arai said it flatly.
He was pale, but he never took his eyes off Kazama.
"If anyone should apologize, it's Kazama."
I'd heard that the quieter someone usually is, the more stubborn they get once they've been pushed too far.
I guess it really {f:is true|is true}.{p}

"Huh, so you're a stubborn one too.
And here I was, planning to forgive you if you'd just apologized nicely."{p}

Kazama stood up with a loud clatter.
"Just why do I have to take that attitude from you, anyway?
Did I do something that terrible?"
"You really don't understand?
Why I'm this angry?"
Arai looked somehow miserable.
"Nope, I don't."
At Kazama's answer, Arai knit his brows.
He looked like he was about to burst into tears{f:.|.}
"...It's because there are people like you!"
Arai screamed.
His voice cracked, but nobody laughed.
There was something in Arai's manner that made it impossible to laugh{f:.|.}{p}

"Because there are fools like you... I... I...☆"
Arai sprang up and lunged at Kazama.{p}
{f:We|We} moved in to pull the two of them apart.{p}

Just then, Arai raised his face.
His eyes were glowing a dull gold.
From his half-open mouth, I caught a glimpse of sharp fangs.
{f:We|We} stood rooted to the spot, as if frozen.{p}
The next instant, Arai sank his teeth into Kazama's stomach.{p}

But Arai had done it.
His mouth, stained bright red, moved slightly.
"I didn't want to do this... but you went and provoked the evil spirit inside me...!"
Then he spun around and ran off.{p}

"Ah..."
{f:I|I} tried to call Arai back.
But no voice came out.
Kazama lay motionless on the floor, his stomach soaked in blood.
"What on earth just happened?"
{f:One of the girls|Someone} said it in a tearful voice.
What had happened......
That was something no one {f:would ever be able to|could possibly} answer.
The stench of blood filled the cramped club room.
Who could have imagined the seven wonders would come to an end like this?
The sobbing of {f:the girls|the others} sounded somehow far away.
{f:I|I} could do nothing but stand there.
No one ever learned where Arai went.{p}

"Stop it, both of you!"
{f:I|I} stepped in between them.{p}

"Oh, so that was another joke, then?
You really are an irresponsible man.
It's pathetic that someone like you is my senior."
Arai should have left it there, but he kept pushing.{p}
Kazama's anger, which had started to die down, seemed to flare up all over again.{p}

"You want to get hit that badly?
Don't tell me you've got some weird tastes after all.
But I'm a gentleman, you see.
I'll be glad to grant your request."
He clenched his fist tight.
Seen like this, he actually looked the part.
Maybe Kazama was actually incredibly tough in a fight.{p}Should I stop them before it turns into a fistfight{f:?|?}
Stop them
Don't stop them

Kazama glared at Arai, his shoulders heaving.
"He said he wanted to get hit, so I was just trying to grant his request.
{f:What's wrong with that?|Arai's the one at fault here, isn't he?}"
"{f:Please stop fighting.|Please, I'm begging you, stop.}
That's not why we all got together, is it★"
Kazama looked over at Arai with contempt.
"There's no need to get so worked up over stories like these."{p}
{f:I|I} turned toward Arai.{p}

Arai was looking at {f:us|us} with a serious expression.
"You too, Arai, come on, let's make up."
When I said that, Kazama snorted.
"Hmph. Arai doesn't even know any scary stories, does he?
He can't tell one, so he tried to cover it up by picking a fight with me.
Come on, confess."
Arai didn't answer.
But watching their exchange up to now, it did seem like Arai had been deliberately making Kazama {f:angry|angry}.
Why would Arai go out of his way to provoke Kazama like that...?
The silence dragged on for a while.{p}

Don't tell me Kazama had hit the nail on the head?
Just as {f:I|I} was thinking that, Arai opened his mouth.{p}

"...In that case, let me explain.
Though to be honest, we don't have time for this."
The air around him was different from before.
He had the look of someone who had just made a new resolution.
Seeing that face, {f:I|I} found myself thinking I should leave the rest to Arai.{p}

"Please, go ahead."
When {f:I|I} said that, Kazama butted in, sounding displeased.{p}

"I only came because Hino insisted.
I'm going home.
It'd be terrible if I stayed here any longer and caught your stupidity."
Kazama got up from his seat and walked toward the door.{p}

"Still, that Hino sure managed to round up a real bunch of simpletons.
See ya. I'm praying for your project's success."
Kazama wore a mocking smile.
"See ya."{p}
With that, he put his hand on the doorknob.{p}

Suddenly, Kazama's scream thundered through the room.
{f:A black shadow had crept|It looked as if a black shadow had crept} from the doorknob up into Kazama's hand.{p}
When Arai held up his hand, the black shadow around Kazama's hand vanished, as if melting into the air.{p}

"At this rate, our lives are at stake.
It seems the barrier is giving way.
I heard about this project and came hoping to prevent something like this before it happened, but it was no use.
I'm sorry to say it, but someone may have to be sacrificed..."
"If one person is sacrificed, will the rest of us be saved?"
"No matter who it is, the energy released when a life is extinguished is enormous."{p}

{f:I|I} looked around at everyone.
How {f:was I|was I} supposed to choose...
Should {f:I|I} be the one to take responsibility for this gathering{f:...?|...?}
{f:I|I} kept asking myself.
Everyone else was looking around at the others too.
They had to be thinking about who should be the sacrifice{f:.|.}
{f:I|I} wavered.
"There's no time left."
Arai murmured.
{f:I|I} stared at the floor, thinking.
{f:Maybe|Maybe} {f:I|I} really should be the one to be sacrificed...
{f:I|I} made up my mind.
...I would be the sacrifice.
I raised my head to say so and looked at everyone.
Then I saw they were all staring fixedly at a single point.{p}
When I followed their gaze, I found it was fixed on Kazama.{p}

"What!"
Kazama seemed to notice {f:our|our} stares and spoke in an angry tone.
"Why are you all looking at me like that?
You're not seriously thinking of sacrificing me, are you?
It was {c}{f:|} and the rest of you who started this project in the first place."
He sounded like he was trying with all his might to talk everyone around{f:.|.}
But no one took their eyes off Kazama.
"{c}{f:|}, isn't that right?"
Kazama {f:came over and grabbed me|came over and whispered to me}.
"{f:What do you think, huh?|I'm not going to say we should sacrifice you, see.}
{f:Surely|Look}, {f:you're not trying to shove your own responsibility onto me, are you?|why not just make Hino take responsibility? He's the one who got everyone together.}"{p}

{f:I|I} didn't say a word.
I felt as if the hope that I might not have to be the sacrifice was warning me to keep my mouth shut.{p}

"Hey, Arai, {c}{f: will do| can go and fetch Hino now}{f: for that sacrifice you mentioned earlier, right?|, I'm thinking.}"
"{f:I don't mind.|So you're going to sacrifice him?}
{f:Is that all right with everyone|In that case, there's no need to call him}{f:?|. I'll send the spirit to wherever he is.}"
With that, Arai looked around at the group.
"Arai, hurry up and get it over with.
I've got something to do after this, you know.
Besides, {c}{f: might lose his nerve too.| looks like she's scared.}"{p}
Just then, there was a violent noise outside the room.{p}

"The spirit outside seems to be quite powerful.
We may already be done for."
Arai said it while staring at the wall, as though seeing through it to what was outside the room.
"What do you mean, Arai?
You said earlier that {f:if someone was sacrificed, we'd be saved|we'd sacrifice Hino}, didn't you!"
Kazama said it in an angry tone.
"I mean it's no longer a problem that sacrificing one person will solve."{p}

The muscles in Kazama's face were twitching.
"Count me out, thanks.
This farce is over.
You can all just carry on by yourselves.
It's no use trying to fool me with cheap magic tricks like that.
I'm going home now."
Kazama rattled all that off in one breath.{p}

He had lost his mind.
Then he walked toward the door, muttering to himself.{p}
He opened the door and slowly stepped out of the room.{p}

Beyond the door, everything was filled with a pale blue light.
And Kazama vanished into that light.
A little later, his scream thundered out.
Along with Kazama's scream, the pale blue light gradually grew weaker.{p}

"It seems to be over."
Arai murmured, and left the room.{p}

Left behind, {f:we|we} looked at each other for a while, at a complete loss.
Then, once we had calmed down, we quietly went out of the room.{p}

Outside the room was the same school as always.
"Kazama?
Isn't that Kazama lying over there...?"
Someone was lying in the hallway.
{f:I|I} ran over.
Sure enough, it was Kazama.
"Kazama, Kazama... Hm, he's alive... He's alive!"
Everyone ran over and helped Kazama sit up.{p}

He {f:seemed to come to|slowly opened his eyes}.
"Hm, what happened?
Oh, {c}{f:|}, everyone."
The Kazama before us was strangely calm.
He {f:seemed|seemed} to have no memory of anything from around the time he'd fought with Arai.{p}

And so {f:we|we} breathed a sigh of relief.
As {f:we|we} savored the peace we'd won back, a voice spoke from behind {f:me|me}.{p}

"Excuse me, you're all members of the seven wonders project, aren't you?"
Arai was standing behind us, though none of us had noticed him arrive.
"I'm very sorry.
Something came up, so I'm late."
".............."{p}
The seven wonders project was cancelled.{p}
According to Hino, {f:Kazama has mellowed since then and doesn't say ridiculous things anymore.|Kazama mellowed after that and stopped saying ridiculous things.}{p}

Arai went flying and hit his head on a shelf.
He slid limply to the floor.
{f:Oh no|No...}!
{f:I|I} panicked.
After hitting it that hard, he had to be hurt{f:.|.}
{f:My|My} conscience stung a little for not stopping them before it came to this.
I ran over to Arai.
"Are you all right, Arai?"
I took his limp hand.{p}

My heart gave a lurch.
There was no pulse★
I searched frantically, but I still couldn't feel a pulse.
When I held my hand over his face, there was no sign that he was breathing.{p}

"He... he's dead."
My voice trembled.
Everyone seemed stunned.
"Are you serious★"
"Yes... he has no pulse, and he isn't breathing."
A heavy silence enveloped the club room.
Everyone's eyes naturally turned to Kazama.{p}

"...For now, we'd better carry him out of here."
